newsitem.title: USA: Wisconsin ag official to head US Wheat Associates.
newsitem.headline: Wisconsin ag official to head US Wheat Associates.

text.p: Alan Tracy, Wisconsin agriculture secretary since 1990, will become president of U.S. Wheat Associates in August, the organization said Thursday.

Tracy would succeed Winston Wilson, who headed the group since 1991. He was chosen by a search committee. The choice must be ratified by the board of directors. Chairman Joe Berry said Tracy was "very well qualified to serve as president." A farmer and business operator, Tracy also has served as a U.S. Agriculture Department official.
U.S. Wheat Associates is an export-market development organization supported by wheat growers in 18 states.
